Our Story

A Café Made for Slow Mornings by the Sea

Sidestack is a laid-back coffee shop tucked inside Miraya Garden in Dasmariñas, Cavite — the kind of place where the al fresco tables fill up fast and nobody seems to mind staying a while. Cozy indoors or under the open sky, a good cup is never far away.

From earthy matcha to specialty coffee brewed with Yardstick beans, every order is made to slow you down for a bit — the way a good garden café should.

🐾 Dine-in 🥤 Takeout ❄️ Air-conditioned 🌿 Al fresco garden
